public_test_zh: 一条错误如果不能沿原渠道被纠正，这项AI服务就不能留在京张。
public_test_en: If an error cannot be corrected through every channel that carried it, the AI service must not remain in Jing-Zhang.

controlled_demo.advance_gate: both original channels corrected and all four fail-closed field-removal tests pass

stages.gate: stop if the owner, lawful material or same-channel inventory is missing
no adverse result proceeds without human review and expiry
pause the pilot when correction cannot reach an affected channel
continue only with named owner, evidence and resourcing

pilot_chains.name_zh: 京张遗产数字内容误标
route: 沿线实体展签与离线网页
pilot_chains.failure_condition: AI reconstruction is presented as an original historical record
pilot_chains.recovery: freeze the label, correct every display channel, preserve the original record and retest the publishing workflow

pilot_chains.failure_condition: an uncertain detector output delays clinical routing
pilot_chains.recovery: route urgent care first, issue same-channel clarification and revise the triage protocol

pilot_chains.failure_condition: evidence expires or the supplier cannot export data
pilot_chains.recovery: pause renewal, test migration, recover data and update the procurement dossier

resource_bands.S: existing counter plus trained staff and paper/telephone workflow
resource_bands.M: adaptive-reuse room plus isolated test equipment and accessible fit-out
resource_bands.L: multi-organization evaluation facility; requires official spatial, engineering and cost evidence

cost_note: No monetary estimate is asserted before quantities, ownership, building condition and authoritative local cost references are available. Each project records staffing, fit-out, equipment, data, accessibility, audit and recovery components for later quantity-based costing.
